WITH conservation_with_sites AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sc.zoneref,
    s.healtheval
  FROM scanconservation sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
),
counts_by_status AS (
  SELECT
    healtheval,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref) as site_count
  FROM conservation_with_sites
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT
    healtheval,
    site_count,
    CAST(site_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(site_count) OVER () as share
  FROM counts_by_status
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM with_shares
),
filtered_statuses AS (
  SELECT
    ws.healtheval,
    ws.site_count,
    ws.share,
    s.avg_share
  FROM with_shares ws
  CROSS JOIN stats s
  WHERE ws.share > s.avg_share
)
SELECT
  AVG(site_count) as average_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess
FROM filtered_statuses;
